newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Friday as tight supply failed to boost sentiment, dealers said.
"The rains are still pouring in many parts of Sumatra causing tight supply, but demand remains weak after recent sharp rises," one dealer in Pekanbaru, Riau said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries were at 57.00-57.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 56.50-57.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.25-56.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said market talk of possible Chinese buying in the coming days failed to boost the otherwise weak sentiment.
They said China was heard looking for rubber in Malaysia and Thailand.
High amoniac latex remained on offer at 2,260 rupiah/kg in Tangerang and Bandung against the previous 2,350 rupiah due to weak demand.
